items.title: 14.4.10 Particulate matter (PM) (hawa mein tairte nanhe particles) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.10, printed page 310.

blocks.title: Particulate matter (PM)
blocks.text: “Particulate matter (PM)” un bohat nanhi cheezon ko kehte hain jo hawa mein tairti rehti hain, chahe woh solid particles (thos tukre) hon, liquid droplets (qatre) hon, ya dono.

PM hawa mein suspended (latke hue) saari dhool, dhuan aur haze (dhund) ke particles hain. PM mein acids, organic chemicals, metals aur mitti ya dhool ke particles hote hain. PM ke sources natural bhi hain aur anthropogenic (insanon ki taraf se) bhi. Natural sources mein volcano, aag, dust storms (dhool ke toofan) aur hawa mein urne wala samandari namak shamil hain. Human sources mein machines aur factories mein jalna (combustion), gariyon ka dhuan aur tobacco (tambaku) ka dhuan shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: PM10 aur PM2.5 mein farq batayein, aur PM2.5 zyada harmful kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: PM10 woh particles hain jin ka diameter 10 micrometre tak hai; PM2.5 is se bareek, 2.5 micrometre tak. Bareek particles hawa mein zyada der rehte hain aur naak aur gale se guzar kar lungs ki gehrai (alveoli) aur khoon tak pohnch jate hain, is liye PM2.5 zyada jalan aur dil aur lungs ki bimariyan paida karta hai.

items: PM: hawa mein tairte thos particles aur liquid qatre (dhool, dhuan, dhund; acids, organics, metals, mitti).
Natural: volcano, aag, dust storms, samandari namak. Human: combustion, gariyan, tobacco smoke.
